recommendations.text: Monitor pest activity, particularly fall armyworm and cutworm, which have been reported in high severity. Adjust irrigation practices to avoid overwatering, especially for the non-irrigated plot. Use the recent above-normal rainfall to ensure crops are well-watered. Keep an eye on market trends for sorghum prices.
